title: Remove positional coupling from current readiness
objective: Refactor the now-centralized readiness contract so the current state is explicit rather than encoded as tuple position 0, without changing any public behavior.
acceptance_criteria: status() returns `_CURRENT_READINESS` rather than indexing READINESS_STATES by position.
All existing public behavior remains unchanged.
continuation_reason: This is a behavior-preserving implementation refinement directly implied by Gate 004A; it does not change product semantics or public API.
